tracker.research_notes: Seeded 2026-09-30 from Claude's general knowledge; not verified.

triage.why: Nestlé Purina makes pet food; large regulated manufacturer with software QA needs, agriculture-adjacent but not candidate's core domains.

remote_policy.summary: Remote/hybrid work is available in some corporate and field roles; eligibility is role- and leader-dependent, with some teams expected on-site.

signals.summary: Unionized workers at the Nestlé Purina PetCare plant in South Whitehall Township went on strike after rejecting the company's contract offer.
Layoff tracking database lists 85 WARN notices affecting 11,030 workers for Nestlé, sourced from state WARN Act filings.

fit.rationale: Nestlé Purina is a global pet-food and animal-feed manufacturer; the candidate's interest in agriculture/feed makes it topical, but quality roles there are food-safety and plant QA rather than software SDET work, and openings and Maine-eligible remote are unconfirmed.

research.approach_role: Director of Quality Assurance (or Head of IT Quality Engineering)
research.outreach_angle: Your FDA-regulated V&V and design-controls background maps to Purina's validated, audited quality systems; you could bring automated test tooling to plant and corporate quality workflows.
research.red_flags: No QA openings listed; recent Nestlé layoffs (11,030 across WARN notices) and a Purina plant strike; remote eligibility varies by leader.
research.notes: Verified: remote/hybrid exists in some corporate and field roles but is role- and leader-dependent, Maine eligibility unknown. No QA openings on file; no contacts listed. Stability signals mixed: huge profitable parent, yet WARN-listed layoffs and a South Whitehall plant strike. Fit rests on regulated-V&V transferability, not software QA demand.
